_frame: Far-away cards for Teluk Flats (lane R5-ART, GPT Image through the Codex bridge, transparent background, alpha kept). Each card stands on its bottom edge: base_row = the lowest content row in pixels (the base line); the area above the content is transparent. size_m = a suggested world size {w, h} in metres from the real heights of what is drawn (Monas ~132 m, ship-to-shore cranes ~115 m with the boom up, tower cranes 40-70 m, a storey ~3.3 m). The skylines fade to zero alpha over 64 px at both ends so they can overlap in a ring. Haze is painted in; the world fog adds more. 'extra' = single cranes / frames and a container strip, made but NOT in public/ (lane WORLD's horizon.js takes every img/teluk/card-*.webp by name; they ship once it sizes cards from this file).

cards.where: far horizon toward the city, 3-8 km out
cards.notes: dozens of towers, two under construction with cranes, Monas a little right of centre (x ~1270 px) in the haze

cards.where: far horizon along the waterfront / the bay's far shore
cards.notes: three container cranes, a container ship and a small white ship on the left, towers and port sheds across; no monument

cards.where: across the bay / beyond the flats (the target's left side)
cards.notes: three ship-to-shore container cranes, booms up, pale blue-grey; the gaps in the frames are transparent

cards.where: around the construction site, off the line
cards.notes: four tower cranes 40-70 m tall, orange-yellow and white, hooks out; the lattice gaps are transparent

cards.where: mid distance on the skyline side (the target's right), 1.5-3 km out
cards.notes: three unfinished concrete frames (20, 14 and 9 storeys), a tower crane on the tallest; open floors are partly see-through
